datasheet_identity.title: S10AC THRU S10MC Surface Mount General Purpose Rectifier (SMC/DO-214AB)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet S10AC THRU S10MC; S10JC column: VRRM = 600 V, VRMS = 420 V, VDC = 600 V (p. 1 maximum ratings).
Absolute maximum ratings for operating-region use only (never fitted): IF(AV) = 10.0 A at TL per fig. 1, IFSM = 200 A at 8.3 ms half-sine, Tj = -55 to +150 degC (p. 1).
Full manufacturer name on the datasheet: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com).

Fig.3 curve digitized from the PDF vector path (bezier control points), axes calibrated against tick-label coordinates; x linear 0.2-1.6 V, y log 0.1-100 A. The plotted curve spans 0.51 V / 0.10 A to 1.46 V / 96 A.
High-temperature reverse leakage row IR2 = 200 uA at VR = VDC, TA = 125 degC (p. 2) transcribed here as a note only; per archetype it must not be fitted.

Fig.1 (forward current derating vs lead temperature), Fig.2 (peak forward surge vs number of cycles) and Fig.4 (reverse current vs percent of rated peak reverse voltage, 25/125 degC) are present but not digitized: they are thermal/surge ratings or percent-normalized family curves, not per-part electrical model inputs.
No reverse recovery time is published for this series; reverse_recovery is null.
No measured breakdown row exists (VRRM is a rating, not a measured breakdown); breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
source_kind 'typical' on specified test currents means 'exact specified test condition'; the schema enum has no dedicated value for test conditions.
